fieldValues.title: 9. The boards
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Five GitHub Projects: #5 'SRS' (1,347 items), #6 'SemanticOps' (557), #4 'MuDemocracy' (37), #3 'mu democracy roadmap' (38) and #2 'SemOps Agent Workflow' (0). #6 is written hourly by srs-programme's Board sync workflow (the clerk's reusable programme-board-sync, project from the programme settings), and its priority by Derive priority. #5 has had no writer since srs-rust's board-sync.yml was retired on 2026-10-11 (commit dd8e47a8); only a manual run of the old script could still write it.
fieldValues.tensions:
- #5 still holds 1,347 items that look live but are not maintained.
- #2 is empty; #3 and #4 are small and may be unused.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Which projects can be archived without losing anything an agent reads?
fieldValues.next_action: Done 2026-10-25: Project #5 closed (reversible with gh project close 5 --undo). #2, #3 and #4 are left for the owner to judge.
